title: Electron Desktop App
description: Step-by-step workflow for building a secure, cross-platform desktop application using Electron, Vite, and React with proper IPC and auto-updating.

steps.title: Desktop App Concept & Target Platforms
steps.goal: Define the core utility of the app and which OS platforms it targets.
steps.expectedOutput: Target OS list (Mac/Win/Linux), core desktop utility, and main user workflow.
steps.prompt:
I am building an Electron Desktop App called "{{project.name}}".
The concept is: {{project.idea}}.
My experience level is {{project.experienceLevel}}.

1. Define the core utility this app provides as a desktop application vs a web app.
2. List the target platforms (e.g., Windows, macOS (Intel/Silicon), Linux).
3. Detail the main user workflow from app launch to achieving the primary goal.

steps.title: MVP Scope & Window Management
steps.goal: Map out the UI windows, system tray interactions, and core MVP features.
steps.expectedOutput: List of windows, tray behavior, and 3-5 core MVP features.
steps.prompt:
Scope the MVP for "{{project.name}}" targeting {{decisions.platforms}}:
1. Define the window model (single main window, multiple utility windows, frameless window, system tray app).
2. List 3-5 MVP features with clear user stories.
3. Define the offline capabilities of the app.
4. List 5 explicit V1 non-goals.

steps.title: Build Tooling & Frontend Framework
steps.goal: Select the scaffolding tool (e.g., electron-vite), frontend framework, and local DB.
steps.expectedOutput: Chosen frontend framework, build tool, and local data persistence strategy.
steps.prompt:
Recommend the specific tech stack for our Electron app based on my experience level ({{project.experienceLevel}}):
1. Frontend Framework (e.g., React, Vue, Svelte) and styling library.
2. Build Tooling (e.g., electron-vite, Forge, electron-builder).
3. Local Data Persistence (e.g., better-sqlite3, electron-store, lowdb).
4. Justify each choice specifically for an Electron environment.

steps.title: IPC (Inter-Process Communication) Security
steps.goal: Design the IPC bridge between the Main process and Renderer process.
steps.expectedOutput: Context isolation strategy and list of exposed API methods.
steps.prompt:
Design the IPC communication strategy for "{{project.name}}":
1. Explain how Context Isolation will be enforced.
2. Draft the API surface for the `preload.js` script (what methods will `window.api` expose?).
3. Map out the main events and handlers needed for our MVP features (e.g., reading files, triggering notifications).

steps.title: Project Scaffold & Dependencies
steps.goal: Initialize the project using electron-vite and install dependencies.
steps.expectedOutput: Terminal commands to scaffold the project and `package.json` updates.
steps.prompt:
Provide the exact terminal commands to scaffold a new Electron app using {{decisions.buildTool}} with {{decisions.framework}}.
1. List the commands to create the app and install core dependencies.
2. Provide the initial `electron.vite.config.js` or equivalent config file.
3. List the scripts to add to `package.json` for dev, build, and package.

steps.title: Main Process & Window Setup
steps.goal: Implement the main entry point and window lifecycle.
steps.prompt:
Write the initial Main Process code for the app:
1. Implement `src/main/index.js` to create the {{decisions.windowModel}}.
2. Handle window lifecycle events (ready, window-all-closed, activate).
3. Implement `src/preload/index.js` with the context isolation setup we designed earlier.

steps.title: Renderer Setup & UI Layout
steps.goal: Set up the frontend application and main UI layout.
steps.expectedOutput: Code for the main frontend entry point and core layout component.
steps.prompt:
Write the initial Renderer Process code using {{decisions.framework}}:
1. Provide the `src/renderer/index.html` structure.
2. Write the root application component (e.g., `App.jsx` or equivalent) that includes the main navigation and layout.
3. Demonstrate calling one IPC method from the UI (e.g., getting app version or pinging main).

steps.title: Native OS Integrations
steps.goal: Implement native features like notifications, file dialogs, or global shortcuts.
steps.expectedOutput: IPC handler implementations for native OS features.
steps.prompt:
Implement the IPC handlers in the Main Process for our native integrations:
1. Based on our IPC strategy ({{decisions.ipcStrategy}}), provide the code to handle native events (e.g., native file dialogs, system notifications, or global shortcuts).
2. Show how these handlers are registered in `src/main/index.js`.

steps.title: Local Data Persistence
steps.goal: Implement local storage using the chosen database or store.
steps.expectedOutput: Store implementation and IPC exposure for data operations.
steps.prompt:
Implement local data persistence using {{decisions.database}}:
1. Write `src/main/store.js` to initialize the local database or store.
2. Write the CRUD operations needed for the app's core state.
3. Explain how the Renderer process requests data via IPC.

steps.title: Auto-Updating Setup
steps.goal: Integrate electron-updater for seamless OTA updates.
steps.expectedOutput: Code for checking and downloading updates.
steps.prompt:
Set up auto-updating using `electron-updater` for {{decisions.platforms}}:
1. Write `src/main/updater.js` to handle `checking-for-update`, `update-available`, and `update-downloaded` events.
2. Show how to trigger the updater from the Main Process on app launch.
3. Detail the GitHub/S3 publisher configuration needed.

steps.title: Security Audit & Hardening
steps.goal: Ensure node integration is disabled and web preferences are secure.
steps.expectedOutput: Checklist and code updates to harden Electron security.
steps.prompt:
Audit and harden the Electron configuration:
1. Verify `nodeIntegration: false` and `contextIsolation: true`.
2. Implement `webContents.setWindowOpenHandler` to securely handle external links.
3. Implement a strict Content Security Policy (CSP) in `index.html` and HTTP headers.
4. Ensure webSecurity is enabled.

steps.title: Packaging & Distribution
steps.goal: Configure electron-builder to generate installers for target platforms.
steps.prompt:
Configure the packaging pipeline for "{{project.name}}" targeting {{decisions.platforms}}:
1. Provide the complete `electron-builder.yml` configuration (including mac/win/linux targets, appId, icons).
2. Write a GitHub Actions workflow (`.github/workflows/build.yml`) to automatically build and publish drafts to GitHub Releases on tag pushes.
